title: Magnetic 3d−4f Chiral Clusters Showing Multimetal Site Magneto-Chiral Dichroism

material_class.structural_family: hydroxido-bridged sandwich-like {Ln5Ni6} cluster with compressed trigonal-bipyramidal {Ln5} core

synthesis.procedure: (R)-H3L (N-(2-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzyl)-D-serine; 0.06 g, 0.25 mmol), Ni(Ac)2 (0.5 mol L−1, 1.5 mL), and Dy(ClO4)3 (1.0 mol L−1, 1.25 mL) were added to 10 mL of deionized water. The solution was heated to about 80 °C, and freshly prepared aqueous NaOH (0.5 mol L−1) was added dropwise to incipient permanent precipitation (pH ≈ 6.4). The mixture was refluxed for 2 h and filtered. Evaporation of the filtrate under ambient conditions afforded grassy rhombic crystals after 1 day (0.22 g for the 1-(R/S) pair).

reagents.name: sodium hydroxide
reagents.amount: aq. 0.5 mol L−1, dropwise to pH ≈ 6.4

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate evaporated under ambient conditions to grassy rhombic crystals
synthesis.yield: 37% based on Dy(ClO4)3 (1-(R)); 0.22 g reported for 1-(R/S)

properties.summary: DC magnetometry shows room-temperature χMT consistent with uncorrelated DyIII/NiII ions and a low-T rise to 114.1 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K, indicating ferromagnetic Dy–Ni coupling plus Dy anisotropy (M = 42.37 μB mol−1 at 2 K, 7 T). Optical spectra show NiII d–d and DyIII f–f absorptions; NCD, MCD, and single-crystal MChD reveal intense multimetal-site magneto-chiral dichroism, with Ni-centered MChD driven mainly by natural optical activity and Dy-centered MChD by magnetic optical activity. gMChD = 0.016 and 0.020 T−1 at ca. 810 and 910 nm.

properties.summary: YIII is diamagnetic, so magnetism reports the NiII sublattice: χMT = 7.4 cm3 mol−1 K at RT, falling to 5.0 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K (AF coupling and/or Ni ZFS); M = 12.65 μB mol−1 at 2 K, 7 T. Optical spectra show NiII d–d bands (ca. 600, 770, 1000 nm). Used as the spectroscopic reference isolating Ni-centered NCD/MCD/MChD versus Dy-centered signals in 1.
